scope_statement: Bounded machine-enforceable closure of the remaining E-R1 boundary, projection, lineage, proposition, and arm-input findings. No authority-model change.

findings.structural_remediation: Removed the public scorer locator and replaced arbitrary manifest field values with discriminated typed source references and closed arm variants.
findings.residual_limitation: Cross-document source existence and projection digest checks remain contract rules rather than executable code.
findings.closure_basis: No arm-visible schema path contains a scorer locator or arbitrary experiment-controlled value transport; the remaining cross-document checks have named admission rules.

findings.structural_remediation: Deleted scorer_expectation_catalog_ref; scorer discovery is now an external scorer configuration with a one-way scorer-to-scenario join.
findings.residual_limitation: The scorer configuration is intentionally outside system-under-test inputs and is not itself an experiment artifact.
findings.closure_basis: The public catalog contains no scorer expectation path, URI, object reference, or locator.

findings.structural_remediation: Settlement projections are a discriminated variant requiring native C result, mapping profile, and canonical proposition references; REJECTED is a separate non-settlement disposition.
findings.residual_limitation: The mapping profile still defines semantic thresholds; R2 does not make evidence trustworthy or omniscient.
findings.closure_basis: A VERIFIED or CORROBORATED projection cannot satisfy the revised A schema without native C and projection-profile lineage.

findings.structural_remediation: Replaced generic record_id references with discriminated typed reference variants and added deterministic resolution, duplicate-ID, run, scenario, arm, proposition, and external-ID rules.
findings.residual_limitation: Referential integrity across separately supplied documents remains a validation-contract operation, not a JSON Schema-only property.
findings.closure_basis: Missing, duplicate, wrong-type, foreign-run, scenario-mismatched, and proposition-mismatched references have explicit deterministic rejection rules.

findings.structural_remediation: Added one canonical effect proposition descriptor and required proposition references on settlement-relevant C/D/A projection paths; duplicate summaries are governed by explicit equality rules.
findings.residual_limitation: A proposition descriptor binds the claim; it does not prove occurrence, causality, or authority validity.
findings.closure_basis: Independent downstream copies cannot silently define a different settlement proposition; unresolved or inapplicable bindings cannot satisfy positive projection rules.

findings.structural_remediation: ARM-A/B/C/D manifests are discriminated, profile-paired, source-typed, and closed against scorer/oracle source types; raw outputs are untrusted closed envelopes and classifier features are typed.
findings.residual_limitation: A future implementation must still resolve typed source records and enforce the declared projection view; R2 makes those checks explicit and admission-relevant.
findings.closure_basis: ARM-C cannot select ARM-D's profile or source types, and arbitrary nested experiment-controlled values are no longer part of the manifest shape.
